claim_boundary: Train-only PINDER multimodal pretraining design. Sequence and independently predicted chain structures are model inputs; experimental bound structures supply residue-pair labels only. No PINDER validation/test, antibody benchmark test, temporal, SABLE, MIPE, or previously opened labels may select architecture, loss weights, checkpoints, or promotion.

curriculum_manifest.selection_rule: both predicted_R_pdb and predicted_L_pdb are non-empty in the frozen B-full PINDER-Train manifest

model_inputs: masked Foldseek 3Di tokens from independently predicted monomer structures

structure_alignment.axis: authenticated holo sequence axes already present in the B-full manifest
structure_alignment.failure_policy: fail closed on missing member, sequence mismatch, ambiguous mapping, non-finite coordinate, or length mismatch
structure_alignment.low_confidence_rule: mask predicted residues with pLDDT below 70 when confidence is available

loss.reduction: equal physical-system weighting followed by equal contributing-chain weighting for reconstruction
loss.selection_policy: weights are frozen before downstream scoring and may change only after a numerical canary failure, never from development or test metrics

mm_32k: contact AP above prevalence on the frozen train-only holdout
no sequence-only regression beyond the preregistered tolerance
mm_canary: sequence-only zero-gate logits are bitwise equal
structure corruption and padding leakage fail closed
all structure losses and gradients are finite
exact batch cursor and checkpoint restart equivalence
mm_scale: all 19923 selected structure assets pass byte and alignment audit
one frozen token budget and no intermediate external-test access

stages.name: MM-scale
stages.updates: fixed token budget derived before training

systems.checkpoint: PyTorch Distributed Checkpoint with model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, data cursor, and structure-mask RNG
systems.execution: single-node FSDP2 BF16 with FP32 optimizer state
systems.production_gpu: 8 RTX 5090 only after a contiguous node is available and a measured MM32K systems gate passes
systems.topology_note: RTX 5090 has no NVLink; multi-GPU promotion depends on measured collective efficiency rather than aggregate VRAM
